name: Cutthroat Grapple
text:
Trigger A creature attempts to Escape from your Sawtooth Grapple.

---
You can punish a creature that tries to escape your blades. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. On a hit, the creature takes a –4 circumstance penalty to its Escape attempt and 1d6 bleed damage.

Effect: Cutthroat Grapple
